description.p: Aether is a fast IDE for Linux built on GTK 4. It detects your project's build system (Make, CMake, Meson, Cargo, Go, Zig, npm), builds with clickable errors, and debugs C, C++, Rust and Go with gdb: breakpoints, stepping, variables, watches and the call stack.
It also has language servers, git, an outline, code folding, multiple cursors, 39 themes, a theme studio and a built-in terminal.
